I bought this Safari large trolley bag from Amazon in June 2025, and within less than a year of normal use, the outer polycarbonate shell cracked near the wheel area. The product description mentions an “unbreakable polycarbonate shell,” but my experience was completely different. The damage happened during regular travel, without any extreme mishandling. The crack is serious enough to affect the structure and usability of the bag. For a brand that promotes durability and strength, this is disappointing. I would suggest the company be more realistic in their claims. If you’re buying this expecting long-term durability, please be cautious. Overall, not worth the price considering the quality.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Stylish, Durable & Worth the Money (Delivery Slightly Delayed) I recently purchased this 3-piece trolley bag set from Aristocrat, and overall I’m really impressed with the quality and design. First of all, the color combination (olive green with yellow accents) looks very premium and unique—definitely stands out from regular luggage. The hard shell body feels sturdy and durable, which gives confidence for long trips and rough handling during travel. The 360° spinner wheels are super smooth, making it very easy to move the bags around even when fully loaded. The trolley handles are strong and adjustable, and the zippers feel high-quality as well. All three sizes (small, medium, large) are very practical—perfect for different travel needs. Also, the bags came well-packed and in proper condition. The only small issue was that delivery was delayed by 1 day, but considering the product quality, it wasn’t a big concern. ✅ Pros: Premium look and finish Strong and durable body Smooth wheels & easy handling Value-for-money combo set Cons:1-day delivery delay Overall, I would highly recommend this set to anyone looking for stylish and reliable luggage 👍

I was initially impressed by the sleek and stylish look of the Nasher Miles trolley bag. However, my excitement quickly turned to disappointment when I noticed that the handle bracket was broken right out of the box. This is a critical part of the bag, and its poor quality makes the entire product unreliable. While the design is appealing, it’s clear that the quality doesn’t match the appearance. I expected much better durability for the price I paid. A broken handle bracket renders the bag almost unusable, and it’s frustrating to deal with such an issue with a brand that claims to deliver quality products. Unfortunately, I cannot recommend this bag unless Nasher Miles improves their quality control. A good look is pointless if the bag can't hold up to basic use.
Best product with premium look...

The suitcase is spacious, stylish, and overall the build quality is good. However, one of the wheels broke during our travel. On the positive side, the company was very prompt in sending a replacement wheel under warranty, which I really appreciated. That said, I do feel the wheel quality could be improved. I purchased a suitcase from Safari at the same time and both were handled in a similar way during travel, but the wheels on the Safari suitcase seem sturdier compared to Nasher. Overall, Nasher has a better design and build aesthetics, but improving the wheel quality would make it an even better product.
